title: Tim Tebow and Wife Demi-Leigh Welcome Baby Girl - NewsBreak
text: There’s no denying that even at just 37 years old, Tim Tebow has accomplished plenty, both on the football field and in life. The former Heisman Trophy winner and BCS National Championship Game MVP earned numerous accolades during his four seasons at the University of Florida. Tebow went on to play for five NFL teams from 2010-21. He even took a swing at a minor league baseball career. These days, he remains a major influence in and around the world of sports. But nothing Tebow has done quite compares to what happened on July 6. He and his wife, Demi-Leigh, welcomed their first child, a baby girl named Daphne. The couple shared the news on Instagram, posting: “Our daughter is here! We couldn't be more grateful for the blessing and gift of this new little life,” and “We can’t wait to share her name with you soon 🤭.” Just a few days later, on Wednesday, Demi-Leigh returned to Instagram with heartfelt words about her husband: “Last week when we brought Daphne home. 🩷 Tim’s face in the second slide says it all 🥹. He’s just so proud!” The post quickly drew love and congratulations from fans and friends. “I can’t get enough!!! Love her ❤️,” ESPN and SEC Network's Laura Rutledge said. Sage Steele: “Perfection 🩷 congrats Tim & Demi!” ESPN's Sage Steele commented. “Congrats! She is beautiful! Can’t wait to see all the pups with her!” a fan chimed in. “Beautiful family🙏” said a fan. “Congratulations! She’s beautiful,” writes another. “Congratulations she is Beautiful. God Bless your Family Always 🙏💖," a follower commented. © Maria Lysaker-USA TODAY Sports Tim Tebow and Demi-Leigh Tebow got engaged in January 2019 and married a year later. Tim is now a member of the College Football Hall of Fame and runs the Tim Tebow Foundation, one of the largest organizations helping individuals with developmental and intellectual disabilities experience inclusive events, including its signature Night to Shine prom. Demi-Leigh Tebow, who grew up in South Africa, won Miss Universe in 2017, her country's second title. Shortly after welcoming their daughter, she shared the meaning behind her name , Daphne Reign, a name chosen to reflect both beauty and strength.
